name: io.github.kennzyoguh-lang/kaldrix-connect
title: Kaldrix and Zentrix
description: Let an AI assistant pay suppliers inside a signed spending limit. Test service, pretend bank.

environmentVariables.name: KALDRIX_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of the Kaldrix test service. Defaults to the public test service.

environmentVariables.name: KALDRIX_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The limited agent key from your own test account. It can pay inside a permission and read payments, nothing else.
